hints.title: In-Order Leaf Sequence Collection
hints.text: Traverse each tree from left to right, collecting values of leaves that possess neither left nor right children.

hints.title: Childless Node Filter
hints.text: During traversal, append a node value to the sequence only when both its left child and right child are null.

hints.title: Sequence Equality Check
hints.text: Obtain leaf lists for both roots through depth traversal and compare whether both ordered sequences match.

hints.title: See the blueprint

complexity.notes: Depth-first traversals collecting ordered leaf sequences.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Comparing overall tree topologies fails because internal structures can differ while leaf sequences match.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Leaf arrays and recursion stacks scale with tree sizes.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Perform clean traversal gathering leaf values in left-to-right order.
